data.long_meaning: Ekaparnika refers to a one-wheeled vehicle. In Hindu mythology, this name is associated with the god Vishnu, who rides a divine chariot with one wheel. The name symbolizes stability, strength, and divine protection. The name Ekaparnika carries the meaning “One–Wheel” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ekaparnika usually hope their child will grow to embody one–wheel and live with faith, good character and purpose.

historical_references.reference: The term 'Ekaparnika' is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Eka' meaning 'one' and 'Parnika' meaning 'boat'. It is believed to have originated in the Mahabharata epic, where it is mentioned as the name of a chariot that was shaped like a boat and had only one wheel. This chariot was used by the Pandava prince Bhima during the Kurukshetra war. The significance of the name lies in the fact that the chariot was unique in its design, just like Bhima who was the strongest and most unique among his brothers.

Another reference to 'Ekaparnika' can be found in the Puranic literature, specifically in the Agni Purana. According to this text, the god Agni once took the form of an Ekaparnika chariot to travel across the universe. The chariot was pulled by the seven horses of the sun and represented the power and omnipresence of the god Agni.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Ekaparnika' is derived from Hindu mythology and translates to 'one-thousand-petaled lotus'. In modern context, this name is seen on various digital platforms, representing different trends. On Instagram, it's used by accounts dedicated to Vedic astrology, where the lotus symbol represents the divine and spiritual aspects of one's birth chart. On Reddit, 'Ekaparnika' is used as a subreddit title for discussions on digital art inspired by ancient Indian culture and mythology, reflecting the blending of traditional and modern artistic expressions. On Pinterest, 'Ekaparnika' can be found in boards on spirituality and mindfulness, with images and quotes that evoke a sense of inner peace and enlightenment.
